author: Ari Koslow
title: Byron Buxton (hip) remains out of lineup Wednesday
desc: Byron Buxton is not in the Twins lineup on Wednesday against the Astros.
impact: Buxton is sitting a third straight game. He remains day-to-day.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jackson Chourio goes yard in win over Reds
desc: Jackson Chourio went 2-for-4 in Tuesday's 7-2 win over the Reds with a home run, one walk, one run scored, and two RBI.
impact: Chourio continues a impactful stretch, getting on base in 10 of his last 11 contests. The outfielder continues to reward manager Pat Murphy with a dynamic bat at the top of the Brewers lineup, carrying an .882 OPS with 12 home runs, 33 RBI, 34 runs scored, and six stolen bases across 49 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jake Bauers picks up three hits in win over Reds
desc: Jake Bauers went 3-for-4 in a 7-2 win over the Reds with a solo home run and three runs scored.
impact: Bauers continues a solid stretch at the plate, driving in runs in four of his last seven contests. The veteran remains one of the more explosive bats in the Brewers lineup for manager Pat Murphy, posting an .885 OPS with 15 home runs, 50 RBI, 49 runs scored, and five stolen bases across 74 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Sal Frelick racks up three hits in win over Reds
desc: Sal Frelick went 3-for-4 in Tuesday's 7-2 win over the Reds with a double, one run scored, and one RBI.
impact: Frelick has caught fire at the plate, picking up hits in each of his last six contests. The outfielder remains one of the more streaky bats in the Brewers lineup, batting .252 with three home runs, 31 RBI, 30 runs scored, and six stolen bases across 78 games.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Pedro Avila opts out of contract with Guardians
desc: Guardians right-hander Pedro Avila has opted out of his contract and will become a free agent.
impact: Avila re-signed with the Guardians on a minor-league deal in March, but has yet to see big-league action this season. As a result, the 29-year-old has exercised his July 1 opt-out and will hit the open market.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Brandon Sproat grinds out win against Reds
desc: Brandon Sproat allowed two earned runs on four hits and two walks while striking out seven over 5 1/3 innings in Tuesday's win over the Reds.
impact: Sproat has offered mixed results on the mound of late, allowing three earned runs or more in three of his last six contests. The right-hander remains one of the more underwhelming options as part of a talented Brewers rotation for manager Pat Murphy, posting a 3-4 record and 9.6 K/9 ratio with a 5.28 ERA and 1.33 WHIP across 16 appearances this season.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Luis Arraez goes yard in loss to Diamondbacks
desc: Luis Arraez went 3-for-4 in Tuesday's loss to the Diamondbacks with a solo home run and a triple.
impact: Arraez continues a dynamic stretch at the plate, recording hits in 23 of his last 25 contests. The infielder continues to offer manager Tony Vitello one of the more reliable bats in a streaky Giants lineup, slashing .331 with four homers, 32 RBI, 43 runs, and six steals through 80 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Rafael Devers goes deep in loss to Diamondbacks
desc: Rafael Devers went 1-for-2 in loss to the Diamondbacks with a solo home run and two walks.
impact: Devers has heated back up at the plate, picking up hits in seven of his last eight contests. The first baseman remains one of the more streaky bats in the Giants lineup for manager Tony Vitello, slashing .242 with 15 home runs, 44 RBI, and 39 runs through 85 games.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jackson Jobe (elbow) to throw second live bullpen session Thursday
desc: Tigers right-hander Jackson Jobe (elbow) will throw his second live bullpen session on Thursday.
impact: Jobe, recovering from June 2025 Tommy John surgery, hit 100 mph in his first live bullpen session on June 27, and will face hitters again on Thursday. He is expected to return sometime in August after a rehab assignment.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Landen Roupp implodes early in loss to Diamondbacks
desc: Landen Roupp allowed six earned runs on five hits and six walks while striking out four over 2 2/3 innings in Tuesday's loss to the Diamondbacks.
impact: Roupp has offered mixed results on the mound of late, allowing four earned runs or more in three of his last six contests. The right-hander continues to frustrate fantasy managers as one of the more inconsistent options in the Giants rotation, posting a 4.55 ERA and 1.37 WHIP with a 5-8 record and 10.0 K/9 ratio across 17 starts.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Javier Baez (ankle) begins running and hitting program
desc: Tigers utility player Javier Baez (ankle) has initiated a running and hitting program.
impact: Baez has been sidelined since suffering an ugly-looking ankle injury while stepping awkwardly on first base in an April 28 game against the Braves. The veteran remains without a timetable to return, but it appears his slow-moving rehab has taken a notable step forward.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Gleyber Torres (oblique) begins running progression
desc: Tigers second baseman Gleyber Torres (oblique) is completing a running progression along with rehab exercises.
impact: While Torres beginning to run is a positive sign, it's worth noting that he is not yet ready to resume hitting. The 29-year-old has had two injured list stints this season due to his oblique, but has been excellent when healthy, hitting .280 with four homers, a 15.3% BB% and a .790 OPS through 43 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Vinnie Pasquantino (hand) hopeful to begin rehab assignment soon
desc: Vinnie Pasquantino is hopeful to begin a rehab assignment before the All-Star break.
impact: Pasquantino will continue his rehab in Arizona to begin July. He landed on the injured list a couple of weeks ago and underwent surgery to remove a fractured hamate bone in his right hand.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Mickey Moniak goes yard in loss to Marlins
desc: Mickey Moniak went 1-for-4 in loss to the Marlins with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Moniak has heated back up at the plate since returning from injury, driving in runs in four of his last five contests. The outfielder offers fantasy managers one of the few impactful bats in the Rockies lineup to this point, posting an .875 OPS with 13 home runs, 32 RBI, 23 runs scored, one stolen base through 51 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tanner Gordon shelled early in return against Marlins
desc: Tanner Gordon allowed five earned runs on nine hits while striking out four over five innings in Tuesday's loss to the Marlins.
impact: Gordon continues a disappointing stretch on the mound, allowing four earned runs or more in three of his last four trips to the mound. Fantasy managers can continue to avoid the pitcher in all formats, posting an 0-2 record and 8.7 K/9 ratio with a 6.69 ERA and 1.59 WHIP across 10 appearances.
